evidence_required: FT-016-AC-009 RED: Dataset Governance has no protected HTTP read projection; GREEN: the exact Plant-scoped paginated list returns authority values for authorized active/retained-history reads and no mutation route; decisive comparison: OpenAPI/response/cursor/auth matrix plus route scan and post-read DB snapshot; artifact: Dataset API evidence under .tasks/TASK-090-T3-FT-016-W2/.
purpose: Supply the minimum backend-owned Dataset fields required by the first-demo PWA without introducing review, lifecycle, evidence, curator, or trainability mutation authority.
success_outcome: GET /api/plants/{plant_id}/dataset-candidates returns the exact safe no-store read-only projection with complete canonical pagination and backend authorization, while every read is non-mutating and fail-closed.
anti_goals: Do not add Dataset POST/PATCH/DELETE, review, transition, split, evidence association, curator invocation, or can_train_on mutation.
Do not derive from Timeline, manifest, filesystem, UI Feed, or provider output, and do not expose internal notes/run hashes/event refs.

stop_conditions: The read cannot be implemented from existing Dataset Candidate authority without changing its schema or lifecycle.
Authorization/retained-history ownership is missing or a new mutable endpoint is required.

constraints: Primary owner is Dataset Governance; the HTTP handler remains transport-only and business/query ownership stays in its service/repository.
The response copies authoritative fields and omits internal/secret data; pagination is canonical keyset continuation.
invariants: Dataset can_train_on remains derived only by Dataset Governance lifecycle authority.
Read access creates no row, event, review, transition, repair, or retained-history mutation.
Unauthorized Plant data is not enumerable.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-009: exact route/shape/auth/pagination/no-store/safe-failure and zero mutation route/state.
T3 harm proof uses isolated candidates/Farms/Plants, captures pre/post database state, and confirms denied/failure/rerun paths create no write.
